note: Mazda's diesel families — RF (2.0 MZR-CD), R2 (2.2 MZR-CD and Skyactiv-D), SH (2.2 Skyactiv-D), S5 (1.5 Skyactiv-D), WL (2.5) and the PSA-built Y6 1.6 — were all recorded as petrol and handed a petrol grade. Skyactiv-G petrols are specified 0W-20 by Mazda; the older MZR and B/F-series take a conventional grade. Capacities are family figures unless stated otherwise.

engines.source: SH-VPTS 2.2 Skyactiv-D and R2 / R2AA 2.2 MZR-CD — Mazda6, CX-5, Mazda3. Particulate filter fitted, so the low-SAPS grade is a requirement. Recorded as petrol.
S5-DPTS 1.5 Skyactiv-D — Mazda2, CX-3. Recorded as petrol.
RF 2.0 MZR-CD / DiTD (RF7J, RF4F, RF3F, RF1G, RF5C) — Mazda6, Mazda5, Premacy, 626. Recorded as petrol throughout.
Y601 / Y655 1.6 MZ-CD — this is PSA's DV6 fitted to the Mazda2 and Mazda3, so it takes the PSA figures used elsewhere in this catalogue. Recorded as petrol.
WL / WLT 2.5 diesel — B-series pickup, BT-50. Pre-DPF; conventional 15W-40 suits hot climates.
Skyactiv-G 1.5/2.0/2.5 (P5-VPS, PE-VPS, PY-VPS) — Mazda2, Mazda3, Mazda6, CX-3, CX-5. Mazda specifies 0W-20 for these high-compression engines; a heavier grade is withheld deliberately.
MZR 1.8/2.0/2.3/2.5 (L813, LF17, LF-DE, L3) — Mazda3, Mazda5, Mazda6, CX-7. API SL/SM with no ACEA requirement.
Z-series 1.3/1.5/1.6 (Z5-DE, Z6, ZY-VE, ZJ-VE) — Mazda2, Mazda3, 323, Demio.
K-series and AJ V6 (KL, KF, K8, AJ, GY) — Xedos, 626, MPV, Tribute.
F-series 1.8/2.0 petrol (FE, FS, FP, F8, F2) — 626, 323, MX-6, Premacy. Pre-1998 designs; 10W-40 suits hot climates.
B-series 1.3-1.8 petrol (B3, B5, B6E, BP-ZE, BP DOHC) — 121, 323, MX-5, Demio. Shared with the Kia Pride and Sephia of the same era.
The older small petrols (NA, TC, UC, E5, E3) — 121, 323, MX-5 NA. Capacity is a family estimate.
